metadata.description: Pass data between screens in KMP apps with a Koin flow scope, the way the official Koin skills expect

plugins.name: koin-flow-scope
plugins.description: One Koin scope per multi-screen flow, opened and closed by one owner class: templates in every Koin style, lifecycle rules, tests and migration checklists so every developer passes data between screens the same way. Works alongside the official koin plugin.
